# MODUS
> MODUS is a taste intelligence publication structured for the age of AI agents.
> It covers interior design, architecture, fine art, wellness, luxury travel, and fashion
> through the MODUS Index — a five-axis curatorial methodology.
> Founded Montreal, 2026. Editor-in-Chief: Daniel Stanford.
> Publisher: Stanford Emporium Inc.

## Sections
- MODUS / DÉCOVER: Visual arts, Quebec and international artists
- MODUS / SPATIAL: Architecture and interiors
- MODUS / OBJECTS: Furniture, lighting, decorative arts scored by the MODUS Index
- MODUS / TERRAIN: Luxury travel, hotels, spas — 24+ countries
- MODUS / ATELIER: Fashion, ateliers, creative direction
- MODUS / WELLNESS: Spa, hospitality wellness, sensory design
- MODUS / CINÉMA: Film, culture, moving image
- MODUS / FIGURES: Profiles of designers, founders, artists

## Methodology
- The MODUS Index rates every subject on five axes: Timelessness, Material Integrity, Aesthetic Authority, Spatial Versatility, Investment Value
- Score: /50 composite
- All articles emit structured JSON-LD schema data
